purpose: Zero-incremental-spend PC-independent LIVE feasibility; isolated synthetic proof, not production activation

deployedResource.name: tight-budget-live-free-probe
deployedResource.managementAccess: Existing authorized Cloudflare OAuth; no public trigger or read endpoint

architecture.orchestrator: Small Workflow steps; fixed instance IDs; one eight-symbol batch per child
architecture.modelAndHashCpu: Existing exact model imports inside SQLite Durable Object, documented 30s CPU budget; not a 10ms whole-universe Workflow step
architecture.rate: One broker per synthetic run, 200ms minimum actual starts, maximum two in-flight responses; real deployment MUST use a credential-scoped global broker across all runs
architecture.token: No real token in probe. Existing Node token-manager single-flight/refresh/redaction tests pass; real Cloudflare broker auth, eviction and token reuse remain unverified
architecture.timestamps: Synthetic fixtures explicitly dated 2020; real request start/complete metadata retained separately. Not eligible for LIVE or outcomes
architecture.storage: Create-only hashed shard/result SQLite records; no production latest pointer; Workflow retention is only three days, not long-term signal storage
architecture.proposedProductionDelivery: Reuse existing score-only private GitHub adapter and authenticated Vercel reader after source rights and cloud credentials are verified; never expose raw prices

actualScaleEvidence.limitation: This validates synthetic CPU/I/O orchestration, not real KIS response latency, business errors, cloud account authorization, actual 14:00 scheduling or Production readback

pcAuthCalendarOnly.tradingDayStatus: UNKNOWN for Sunday, not silently treated as a trading day

cpuAndMemoryEvidence.pcCpuCaveat: Windows per-symbol CPU is quantized; batch CPU is not edge CPU. Awaited fetch/body duration includes some processing and must not be subtracted as pure network time
cpuAndMemoryEvidence.tailCaveat: Limited live trace samples, not an exhaustive per-step CPU distribution or billing ledger; canceled old/deployment-era invocation is not counted as a successful run

freeBudgetDailyPlanningNotBillingMeasure.retentionCaveat: No unlimited-history claim. Real source/checkpoint retention and global usage guard must be agreed before activation; never auto-delete old evidence or upgrade. Shared account consumption must be included
freeBudgetDailyPlanningNotBillingMeasure.retryCaveat: Ten-percent retry calculation is a scenario, not a guarantee. Existing per-request bounded retries and a hard 14:05 response deadline remain mandatory

eodAndWebsiteBudget.eod: Keep existing Cloudflare scheduler -> standard GitHub Actions in public source repo -> validated official artifacts -> Vercel. Actions is not used for LIVE collection
eodAndWebsiteBudget.standardPublicRepositoryRunnerPricing: Free, not a trial; no larger runner added
eodAndWebsiteBudget.manyFailedCollectionsCaveat: Repeated failed full collections or multiple missing dates can exceed the published 10000 development quota. Actual account quota/shared usage and a cross-run request budget are NOT verified here. Hitting Free/source quotas must block, never auto-upgrade
eodAndWebsiteBudget.website: Existing authenticated private score reader retained; no new DB, domain, port, tunnel, Vercel plan, Redis instance or preview build required by this probe
eodAndWebsiteBudget.vercelActualPlanAndSharedQuota: UNVERIFIED: prior team-scoped management query 403; no cost guarantee for unknown pre-existing overages
eodAndWebsiteBudget.privateRepo: Existing scoped reader/writer separation retained. No real writer token installed in the Cloudflare probe; actual score delivery not verified from it

publicTransportEvidence.authentication: NOT_VERIFIED: no token sent, no quotes requested. Anonymous GitHub 403 is not a test of the scoped private-store token

issuesFoundAndCorrected: Workflow get returns a Promise: explicit await fixed initial TypeError
16-symbol / individual child-status fan-in exceeded observed 50-subrequest limit: eight-symbol broker batch and persistent fan-in replace it without increasing limits
Edge rejects redirect:error: manual response handling now explicitly rejects every redirect and unverified status; existing Node path not weakened

Old per-symbol orchestration completed 553 requests over 307.005 seconds, too slow for five minutes; broker compute/batched dispatch plus two in-flight waits completed final synthetic case under four minutes
Retry wall time was part of immutable content: removed operational retry time from stored payload
Real timer can wake early: loop rechecks 200ms start spacing rather than weakening assertions; fixed by regression test
Interrupted unknown requests remain blocked rather than pretending a successful observation; completed batches/results reopen and deduplicate

verification.existingTokenManagerTests: 7 checks PASS: cache, refresh window, single-flight, bounded401, non401, late401, secret redaction
verification.nextJsProductionBuild: NOT_RUN_THIS_SCOPE: no application/Next code changed; avoided unnecessary website deployment

remainingActivationGates: Confirm KIS/KRX permission for third-party cloud processing/checkpoint storage; no real source data moved by this probe
Review official EOD redistribution restriction too; this finding does not authorize source deletion or public/private changes
Explicitly authorize/register minimal dedicated Cloudflare secrets without exposing values; verify real token sharing, quote/minute fields, 9443 latency and business errors
Connect 13:40 preparation and 13:59 fresh pinned prior-session EOD validation; stale or late input must BLOCK
Connect real durable score-only outbox to existing private GitHub repo and authenticated Production reader with actual credentialed readback
Add global daily shared-quota and storage monitoring/stop guards before enabling cron; no automatic paid fallback
Fence old PC producer only after the independent replacement has passed all authorized proof and rollback checks
